metadata.title: Palantir Stock Slides Premarket on Doubts It Can Sustain Pace of Growth

content.text:
Last Updated:
Nov. 3, 2026 6:39am ET
Palantir Stock Slides Premarket on Doubts It Can Sustain Pace of Growth
Palantir reported 96% revenue growth for the third quarter and profit more than doubled from a year earlier. The company even raised its full-year guidance. Chief Executive Alex Karp described the momentum as "unmatched in recent economic history.”
So why are its shares down more than 7% in premarket trading?
Worries about Palantir’s ability to keep up its breakneck pace of growth and justify its $400-billion-plus valuation. Palantir said it struck deals worth $2.9 billion in the quarter, down from $3.4 billion in the prior quarter.
